answer: Each identity must keep an ember burning in a violet-glass lantern at the wharf, staked with fuel. The k-th lantern from one funder costs k cubed in fuel, because the keeper re-checks every earlier flame before lighting the next, so N fakes cost N squared times (N+1) squared over 4: 3,025 for 10, 25,502,500 for 100. Two lanterns in one wharf berth gutter both flames at close.
